title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Diphtheria in Haiti
summary: There is an outbreak of diphtheria in Haiti. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Malaria in Yemen
summary: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Yemen, including in areas that were previously considered low-risk.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Hepatitis A in Canada
summary: Manitoba, Canada is currently experiencing a hepatitis A virus (HAV) outbreak. HAV is contagious and spreads through close person-to-person contact and by eating contaminated food or drink.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in French Guiana
summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in French Guiana. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Malaria in Mayotte
summary: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Mayotte. Malaria is spread by the bite of infected mosquitoes.
